description: Private, read-only follow-up tracking. Keeps appointments, referrals, records and other stated next steps from disappearing. It records what another person or service said should happen; it does not invent clinical next steps. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

items.description: Follow-up items already known to the caller, at most 50 kept. Each item is an object with id (string), action (string), status (open, scheduled, complete or blocked), and optionally owner (string) and dueAt (ISO date text). Complete items are dropped; the rest come back as unresolved. Example: [{"id":"F1","action":"Call the referral office","status":"open","owner":"the person","dueAt":"2026-12-01"}].

name: track_followup
title: Track unresolved care follow-up
